download_light_dialog_wild_data: download the light_dialog_wild dataset from parl.ai into the specified datapath directory
build_light_dialog_wild_dataset: build the light_dialog_wild dataset by downloading raw dumps and processing them into task files
get_fpath_hash: generate a SHA1 hash fingerprint from opt flags to identify a unique dataset build configuration
review_download_manifest: review the download function that reads a manifest file and fetches additional chat dump files
refactor_get_fpath: refactor get_fpath to support additional opt fields for dataset configuration hashing
